title: From RL Papers to Framework Code: Inclusion and Review in Seven Open-Source Training Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2610.28027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practitioners use reinforcement learning methods for language models through training frameworks, so a method that a framework includes is one configuration change away for its users. We measure how often this happens. We trace seven open-source frameworks for RL post-training through their commit histories and link them to 6,939 screened arXiv papers from January 2025 to June 2026. Of 1,598 papers that propose a general RL training method, 37 reached at least one framework. Across five quarterly cohorts of papers, the number included within 180 days stayed between 5 and 7 while the cohorts grew from 72 to 386 papers. Compared with papers from the same quarters, included papers more often trained policies of 30B parameters or more, at 41 against 10 percent, and more often changed a coefficient, clip, mask or weight in the existing loss, at 29 against 9 percent. translated_title: 从强化学习论文到框架代码：七个开源训练框架中的收录与评审
translated_abstract: 从业者通过训练框架对语言模型使用强化学习方法，因此框架收录的方法对用户而言仅需更改一次配置即可使用。我们测量了这种情况发生的频率。我们追踪了七个用于强化学习后训练的开源框架的提交历史，并将其与2025年1月至2026年6月的6,939篇筛选后的arXiv论文相关联。在1,598篇提出通用强化学习训练方法的论文中，仅有37篇进入至少一个框架。在五个季度论文批次中，180天内被收录的数量始终保持在5至7篇之间，而批次规模却从72篇增长到386篇。与同期的其他论文相比，被收录的论文更常训练300亿（30B）参数或更大的策略模型（41%对10%），并且更常在现有损失函数中修改系数、裁剪、掩码或权重（29%对9%）。即使排除维护这些框架的公司自己的论文，这两个差距依然存在。
tldr: 该研究通过追踪七个开源强化学习后训练框架的代码提交历史，发现1598篇提出通用RL训练方法的论文中仅有37篇被框架收录，且收录的论文多为大规模训练（30B+参数）和现有损失函数的小幅修改，揭示了RL研究成果从论文到实际工程应用之间的巨大鸿沟。
en_tdlr: By tracing commit histories of seven open-source RL post-training frameworks linked to 6,939 arXiv papers, this study finds that only 37 of 1,598 general RL training method papers were adopted by frameworks, with included papers favoring large-scale training (30B+ parameters) and minor modifications to existing losses, revealing a substantial gap between RL research and practical adoption.
